arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mastercard_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_brand = 'Mastercard'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions, labelled or not, made on cards whose brand is Mastercard.
assumptions: Counts every transaction regardless of fraud label, since the question asks about all transactions made with Mastercard cards.
Covers the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
